description: Lists the ways to earn 4OVER4 coins, the reward points spent on print orders; use it when someone asks how to earn coins or save on printing. For the customer's own balance use get_my_coins. The limit is optional and no sign-in is needed. Returns each task's title, short description, coins, time and page link; 100 coins are $1. Customer phrases: "how do I earn coins", "ways to get points", "what tasks give coins", "how can I save with rewards".
